verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships a webhook destination that sends event data to any HTTP endpoint (Slack, Discord, or any service that accepts HTTP requests). Functions can filter which events are sent, and the Fetch API allows custom HTTP calls, so a user can subscribe an endpoint to the event stream. Missing for 10: documentation of webhook payload format, signing/auth, and retry semantics; webhook subscriptions to operational events (sync and batch failures, which are documented only as Email/Slack alerts or OTLP export); independent or hands-on corroboration.
